context_map.direction: upstream to downstream; edge devices push Ingress Packets, ingestion conforms to device payload shape
context_map.exchanged_information: Ingress Packets carrying Telemetry Samples with t_device; devices initiate; retries/at-least-once delivery unspecified; nothing about t_ingress ordering leaks back.
context_map.boundary_protection: Boundary validation against Sensor Metric Boundaries, VALIDATION_FAILED tagging, reactive backpressure at the entry point; device model is not adopted internally.

context_map.direction: upstream to downstream; ingestion publishes events, distribution consumes asynchronously
context_map.exchanged_information: Events TelemetrySampleIngested, TelemetrySampleValidationFailed, TelemetryBackfillRevisionAppended with sample, metric, t_device, validation status and revision identity. Raw storage and boundary rules never leak.
context_map.boundary_protection: Published event contracts only; distribution keeps its own transient Windowed Telemetry Stream model and never reads raw storage.

context_map.direction: upstream to downstream; broadcast to downstream event streams and streaming analytics consumers
context_map.exchanged_information: WindowedTelemetryBroadcast: sliding-window telemetry with backpressure-aware delivery; consumers' analytics logic never flows back.
context_map.boundary_protection: Stable published WindowedTelemetryBroadcast schema; consumer demand signalling (backpressure) keeps broadcast non-blocking.

cross_boundary_flows.business_process: Telemetry ingestion to real-time streaming broadcast
cross_boundary_flows.consistency_expectation: Eventual between ingestion and distribution; immediate validation and append-only persistence within ingestion before publishing.
cross_boundary_flows.notes: Failure posture: backpressure, never drop payloads; undefined handling for packets later than the 60s reorder window. FLAG: invariant 'only validated samples propagate' is owned by both contexts (ingestion 'validated before downstream propagation', distribution 'only validated samples') and is contradicted by distribution consuming TelemetrySampleValidationFailed; discovery must assign one owner. FLAG: delivery identity/dedup of retries unresolved. No coupling cycles; dependency is acyclic.

cross_boundary_flows.consistency_expectation: Eventual; revisions appended in ingestion then propagated to windows already broadcast.
cross_boundary_flows.notes: Relation between sliding-window size and 60s reorder window unspecified.
